contract: S0 same-distribution main protocol (freeze candidate). Within each frozen parameter combo, independent repeats only; train/validation/test all cover the same beta x gamma x n grid. P = parameter-precision loss, Q = target x0.95 quantile loss; per-fit paired, only loss route differs. RQ/estimand/inference/matrix in 09-PQ-同分布主协议冻结.md. r4/v3 (gamma/eta-level holdout) retained verbatim as OOD supplement only, not main evidence.
run_mode: PQ_PROTOCOL=iid-v1 (config.py env selector; default stays v3)

split.rule: test: repeat_id % 5 == fold_idx; val: repeat_id % 5 == (fold_idx+1) % 5; train: remainder. Independent of seed and route.

validation.type: repeat class (fold+1)%5; deterministic; seed/route independent; NOT a random fraction

losses.Q: relative x0.95 squared error through Weibull formula

training.support_legality: strict 0 < gamma_hat < min(X) structurally (domain-explicit bounded decoder; relies on frozen positive-gamma domain gamma in [100,1000], min(X)>gamma)
training.no_aux: no log-gap, no auxiliary gamma loss, no straight-through gradient, no route-specific init or decoder

estimated_wall_clock_min.basis: r4 120 fits = 1522 s total (mean 12.7 s/fit) on hermes venv torch 2.12.0+cpu single-thread; iid has 7200 train rows vs r4 9600 (~25% fewer) -> ~9.5 s/fit typical, range 5-20 s

inference.estimand: For each (n, fold, seed) model, matched paired contrast d_{n,f,s} = equal-weight mean over its 2400 held-out paired samples of (rel_sq_Q - rel_sq_P). Design target Delta = equal-weight mean over the frozen (n,f,s) grid (4n x 5fold x 3seed = 60 model-level contrasts); finite-population target over the frozen fold/seed grid, not an infinite superpopulation.
inference.primary: (n, fold) design-unit x seed crossed paired resampling (folds stratified by n with replacement, seeds resampled globally with replacement); B = 200000 for the reported CI, 2000 for smoke/tests
inference.secondary: per-sample bootstrap under fixed models (Monte Carlo interval only, conditional on trained models)

evidence.sha256_rule: tracked files only; text LF-normalized (clean clone portable); .npz binary raw
evidence.key_dtypes: beta/gamma_over_eta float64; n/repeat_id int32; predictions float32

engineering.dedicated_entry: Study/02-study-NN参数估计与分位点目标研究/code/study02pq/
engineering.reuse: existing study02pq pipeline + per-sample evidence; minimal new scripts only for explicit science questions
